verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API ("programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources") and a GraphQL API for managing Pods/templates/endpoints, plus a public pricing page listing GPU types and cost per second, which together imply an agent could query resource/pricing info before deploying. However, no evidence pack item explicitly confirms a dedicated GPU catalog endpoint returning live pricing AND real-time availability (the openapi probe 404s and no gpuTypes/catalog endpoint is cited); community notes only mention experienced 'low availability' issues, not a queryable availability API. Missing for 10: explicit documented catalog/pricing/availability API endpoint or schema, and independent confirmation that live availability data is exposed programmatically.
